the_number_owed: what does one genuinely new computer task cost

setup.page: an inbox the model had never seen: filter input, APPLY button, six messages
setup.pre_registration: the model's four proposals and confidences written to canonical/evaluation/one_new_task/proposals_20261109_v1.json BEFORE anything ran

teach_cost.result: heading reads 'Inbox - 3 shown' with exactly the three urgent messages

reuse_cost.why: the learned trajectory stores the typed value as PIXELS. A new goal ('show only the messages about refund') gets the old word 'urgent' typed, because nothing in the record says which part of the goal produced it.

what_was_fixed.what: a goal-derived literal becomes a SLOT; a new goal fills it
what_was_fixed.measured: 'show only the urgent messages' -> type {slot0}; then 'about refund' -> refund, 'from alice' -> alice, 'the invoice messages' -> invoice, 'billing' -> billing
bugs: the first version bound function words as values: 'about', then 'from'

what_remains_blocked.problem: an EMPTY TEXT FIELD cannot be located by appearance
what_remains_blocked.measurement: a 40x40 patch of the blank input matched 453 offsets spread over 258 px; a 112x112 patch matched 122 offsets
what_remains_blocked.why_thresholds_cannot_fix_it: every threshold that accepts the patch is choosing one of hundreds of equally good places and calling it a match
what_remains_blocked.what_would_fix_it: a structural signal -- the page's own tree -- rather than pixels. The repo already forbids DOM and Accessibility in the visual executor on purpose, so this is a design decision to revisit, not a bug to patch.

the_shape_of_the_last_six_rounds.r65: a demonstration transfers to a new INSTANCE of the taught task (5/5)
the_shape_of_the_last_six_rounds.r66: two skills compose into a task neither was taught; coverage 1+1=3
the_shape_of_the_last_six_rounds.r67: a library is worth what can be FOUND in it; 0/10 in natural language
the_shape_of_the_last_six_rounds.r68: hierarchy does not rescue word overlap; structure decays more slowly
the_shape_of_the_last_six_rounds.r69: the structure result was largely a hand-written lexicon; the model is exact on held-out vocabulary
the_shape_of_the_last_six_rounds.r70: a new task costs 6 model calls and 3 steps -- and the learned procedure cannot yet be reused on a new goal, because the value was stored as pixels and the field cannot be relocated

what_this_does_not_prove: a public benchmark number: still zero
next: give grounding a structural signal so an empty field can be located, and measure whether reuse then works end to end
a public benchmark number, still owed
